scope: Static review of source composition, cleanup assembly and synthetic fixtures. Existing 2181-check standalone validation and its current source/shared-fixture hashes inspected. No additional executable, target DLL, game or OS provider invoked.

Successful calloc has already guarded multiplication and maximum allocation size. The exposed raw-byte span uses the same allocation base and requested byte product on the recovered x64 domain.
errno_05d724 delegates to errno_cell_05d724; invalid_parameter_05c954 delegates to invalid_parameter_noinfo_05c954. Required error/PTD/handler effects remain explicit.

The inherited Entry -> StartupBridge -> LifecycleBridge configuration method is finalized by ArgvBridge, forwarding the same argv State and recovered parser Effects. bit_cast preserves mode DWORD bits before the signed-source API.

cleanup_064538 frees narrow aux, wide aux, narrow argv and wide argv in assembly order. Each following pointer is captured after the preceding free returns and before the preceding cell is cleared.
cleanup mutates the shared State.argv in place and leaves argc unchanged; four free calls including null values are preserved. No RAII or invented exception cleanup was added.
The cleanup fixture mutates following cells during free callbacks and verifies original cells remain visible until the matching clear; synthetic first-free failure does not clear the first cell.

The four composition scenarios cover VCRT FLS availability/fallback combined with explicit command line/module filename fallback; quoted arguments and a DBCS lead plus SPACE trail use actual parser and classification bodies.

Existing successful argv storage/count survive an allocation failure. errno becomes 12; invalid mode returns 22 via the actual invalid-handler path; PTD DOS errno and saved LastError are observed unchanged.

Process detach invokes the recovered cleanup through an initializer-pair cleanup binding; argv allocation/PTD allocations are released while argc remains unchanged; synthetic slot and lock banks are empty.

Module path, multibyte initialization and wildcard expansion remain mandatory pure Policy methods. No silent wildcard success, real module query, native command-line acquisition or hidden production binding was introduced.
limitations: ArgvBridge and ArgvEffects are new source composition, not additional recovered original function counts; only cleanup_064538 supplies a new retained original body here.

Caller must share the same argv State with CleanupState and bind heap/error/invalid/locale providers to the same live allocator and ACRT PTD domains. These borrowed-reference identities and callback lifetimes are caller contracts, not runtime enforced global binding.

Fixture agreement covers the declared bounded normal-flow domain. Full SEH, native module path, multibyte setup, wildcard expansion, native callback ABI/lifetime and complete DLL runtime equivalence are not established.

The integrated fixture exercises mode 1 and invalid modes; production wildcard policy stays required. Mode 2 behavior belongs to separate argv-core tests, not a claimed wildcard provider implementation.
No native or target execution was performed during review; existing standalone execution results are reported as inspected evidence.
